about: The apps Trillion hosts as tool servers (src/hosted-mcp-apps.mjs). Each app is a public GitHub repository whose release ships `<name>-cli`, a headless stdio MCP server; the craft-mcp hosted service (service) installs every pinned release in one container image and parts/stdio-mcp-gateway serves each at https://<host>/<name>/mcp as streamable HTTP. From this file come the image's Dockerfile lines, the gateway's config, the hosted-service and hosted-site rows (scripts/hosted-rows.mjs) and one live tool source per app visible to every account (src/live-tool-source-config.mjs). Adding an app is adding a row to apps: name, repo, release_tag, asset_url (the release's linux-x86_64 tar.gz, which holds <name>-<ver>-linux-x86_64/bin/<name>-cli), BLAKE3 of that archive (blake3, by b3sum), licence, maker, page and clone_of (the product it stands in for), mcp_args (what follows the cli to start its stdio MCP server) and about (plain words people ask for; they are put in front of each tool's job so find_tool_for_job finds it).
